proof_summary: Expand the coefficient as an alternating sum of reciprocal-factorial weights of distinct-part subsets of total size \(n\), grouped by cardinality; on \(T_m\le n<T_{m+1}\), larger layers vanish while weighted deviation-profile fiber bounds show the layers through \(m\) strictly increase, forcing sign \((-1)^m\). Thus consecutive signs differ exactly when the triangular-interval index drops at a left endpoint, with the finite range \(n\le104\) handled directly from the coefficient recurrence.
